gloss: casual player; those who play for fun (slang)

definitions.gloss: casual player; those who play for fun
definitions.explanation: In gaming and hobby communities, people who take part casually for enjoyment rather than competing seriously — the counterpart of ガチ{勢|ぜい} (hardcore players).

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}はエンジョイ{勢|ぜい}だ。
このゲームはエンジョイ{勢|ぜい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This game has a lot of casual players.

examples.japanese: ガチ{勢|ぜい}とエンジョイ{勢|ぜい}では{楽|たの}しみ{方|かた}が{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Hardcore and casual players enjoy the game in different ways.

notes:
Formed from English "enjoy" plus the suffix {勢|ぜい} (a group or faction of people). Labels people who join a game or hobby for fun, without chasing top results — the opposite of ガチ{勢|ぜい}.

REGISTER: Casual slang, common in gaming, fan, and hobby communities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エンジョイ{勢|ぜい}として{楽|たの}しむ: to enjoy it as a casual player

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ガチ{勢|ぜい}: hardcore players — those who play seriously and competitively
